title: Make reviewers flag checks without a production caller and per-item reads or Git launches in ordinary paths
outcome: Make reviewers flag checks without a production caller and per-item reads or Git launches in ordinary paths
acceptance: `.claude/reviewers/architecture.md`, within the pre-code design-review guidance it carries, contains verbatim the rule agreed by Engram::Fable and Kimi::Consultant (c15db92c #523), extended with Greg's clarification (Asistant 43498a6e #1890): "Every new check, audit, validation or full read names its production caller and the operation that triggers it. A check reached only by tests or by a command added for itself is a removal finding. On an ordinary path (sync, export, import, exchange, evaluate, done), a full snapshot/read of unchanged task documents or history, or one process per document when the existing delta suffices, is at least a Medium finding. An explicitly required initial/bootstrap read, reading the changed set, or a full read inside an explicitly needed audit that never runs on an ordinary path is not a finding by itself; one process per document is. Batching does not resolve an unneeded read; remove it."
`.agents/skills/coder-test-execution/SKILL.md` carries the first sentence of that rule for authors before code
Markdown only; built on master after w-f3eefcfe6a2c lands, since it touches the same lens file; the focused link check passes and a Codex plus Claude pair reviews it; no new gate
